name: generateReport
shortDescription: Generates configurable reports on appointments, user engagement, and communication metrics for administrators.
description:
Overview

This function generates various administrative reports, such as appointment summaries, user engagement statistics, or communication metrics. It allows administrators to specify report types and filtering criteria.

Intended use

Called by the admin dashboard UI when an administrator requests a report. Parameters include the reportType (e.g., 'appointments', 'messages'), and optional filters like startDate, endDate, or doctorId.

Logic

  1. Based on the reportType parameter, construct appropriate queries using ctx.data.query or ctx.data.list to retrieve data from relevant entities (e.g., Appointment, Message, Patient, Doctor).
  2. Apply any specified filtering and sorting criteria.
  3. Aggregate and format the retrieved data into a structured format suitable for reporting.
  4. Return the generated report data.

Entities

  • Appointment
  • Patient
  • Doctor
  • Message
